name: test_authored_test_commit_verify
description: Commit a shape-validated agent-authored test, discover how to run it, and red/green-check it -- one task replacing what used to be commit + test_discover + test_authored_test_redgreen plus a SWITCH between them. On any rejection the commit is rolled back so an unproven or unresolved test never rides along in the delivered diff.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repository whose current working tree holds exactly one uncommitted, shape-validated authored test file.

preCandidateCommit.description: The real candidate commit under verification (C0), without the authored test. Rolled back to on any rejection.

message.default: test_cycle: agent-authored test for previously unmapped changes
message.description: Commit message for the one new test file.

testMode.description: Mode used to discover how to run the newly committed test file.

allowHeavySuites.description: Passed through to discovery; only takes effect when testMode is 'full'.

includeBrowserTests.description: Passed through to discovery; only takes effect when testMode is 'full'.

accepted.description: True only when the commit produced a real change, discovery resolved it to a runnable command, and the red/green check accepted it.

reason.description: Why the attempt was rejected (no committable change, discovery could not resolve it, or the red/green verdict); empty when accepted.

commit.description: The new commit SHA when accepted; preCandidateCommit (unchanged, any partial commit rolled back) when rejected.

repairRoots.description: Write-scope roots discovery resolved for the new test file; empty when rejected.

commands.description: The discovered commands that verify the new test file; empty when rejected.

red.description: Result of running the commands with the candidate's real changes rolled back; absent when rejected before the red/green check ran.

green.description: Result of running the commands with the candidate's real changes restored; absent when rejected before the red/green check ran.
